routes.name: diagonal-leaf-flips
routes.retired_because: These edits create new terminal-plus copies, as the manuscript itself explicitly states.

C_EXACT_DISTANCE.statement: For every h>=1, min_edits_H(A_h)=4^h and N_H(A_h)=2*(2^h)^130<=2^h*n_h^130.

C_LOWER_BOUND.statement: Fewer than m^2 arbitrary binary edits leave an H-copy.

C_RADIX_SELECTION.statement: The cyclic-radix m^2 path selections partition the protected cells.

C_PATH_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Avoiding the designated P bodies propagates opposite root bits to one shared leaf.

C_EXPLICIT_REPAIR.statement: Terminal-minus signature suppression is H-free and costs exactly m^2 edits.

C_DELETION_RIGIDITY.statement: Whole variable-to-anchor incidence deletions preserve anchor rigidity and create no H-copies; dummy incidences are unchanged.

C_ANCHOR_PROPERTIES.statement: The literal S has distinct rows and columns, dense first 32 restrictions, minimum row and column weights 58 and 48, and a complete five-bit corner.

C_NONANCHOR_TRACES.statement: Five non-anchor columns have at most 27 traces from non-anchor rows.

C_MODE_INCIDENCE.statement: Each variable position meets at most four modes, with at most one anchor-group one per mode.

C_ORIGINAL_COPIES.statement: Only terminal-minus bodies occur, with p=q and parent column index floor(p/2); counting gives 2*m^130 copies.

C_LEAN_CORE.statement: Unbounded cyclic-radix injectivity, the raw four-body shared-leaf obstruction, common-parity mode classification, and signature/count arithmetic.
